Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Octagonal Metalwork Hanging Geometric Wall Mirror, 28 Inch Height, Black Finish
Colors: Glass
Materials: Metal
Equal parts decor and function, this mirror provides a sculptural focal point. The octagonal mirrored glass is framed by black iron latticework in geometric patterns. Gold accents add to a 3D effect that will enhance a transitional or modern room. 3.7"D x 28"W x 28"H Metal, glass, engineered wood backing Ready to hang, all hardware included
